title: TaskReference
description: JSON Schema enforces field shape and whole-array uniqueness. It cannot compare task_id with task_prerequisite_ids, compare the two prerequisite arrays, or assert identifier ordering; chain validation must reject self-prerequisites, task/external prerequisite overlap, and noncanonical ordering. Schema conformance alone does not establish readiness or authorization.

task_prerequisite_ids.description: Whole-array duplicates are rejected here. Strict ordering and exclusion of task_id are semantic-validator responsibilities.

external_prerequisite_ids.description: Whole-array duplicates are rejected here. Strict ordering and disjointness from task_prerequisite_ids are semantic-validator responsibilities.
